adapter.credentials-refused: {{service}} refused the user name or password.
adapter.not-files: The service at this address answered, but not with {{service}}'s files.
adapter.not-torrents: The service at this address answered, but not with {{service}}'s torrents.
adapter.not-an-add-answer: The service at this address answered, but not the way {{service}} answers a new torrent.
adapter.torrent-gone: {{service}} doesn't have this torrent any more.
adapter.holdings-too-large: {{service}}'s list of every torrent with its files is larger than the app reads ({{limit, size}}), so the app couldn't tell which torrents hold these copies.
adapter.unreadable-answer: The app couldn't read what “{{name}}” answered.

catalog-language.none: {{service}} has no catalog language to choose. Leave catalogLanguage out.
catalog-language.unknown: “{{value}}” is not one of {{service}}'s catalog languages. Use one of the tags its adapter type lists, such as {{examples, list:or}}.

connection.name-too-long_one: An integration name can be at most {{count, number}} character long.
connection.name-too-long_other: An integration name can be at most {{count, number}} characters long.
connection.name-control-characters: An integration name can't contain line breaks or other control characters.
connection.address-missing: An integration needs the address of the service, such as http://192.168.1.10:8096.
connection.address-too-long_one: The address can be at most {{count, number}} character long.
connection.address-too-long_other: The address can be at most {{count, number}} characters long.
connection.address-not-http: The address must be a full http:// or https:// address, such as http://192.168.1.10:8096.
connection.address-user-info: Leave the user name and password out of the address; they have fields of their own.
connection.address-query: The address can't have a query (the part from ?). An API key has a field of its own.
connection.address-fragment: The address can't have a fragment (the part from #).
connection.user-name-too-long_one: A user name can be at most {{count, number}} character long.
connection.user-name-too-long_other: A user name can be at most {{count, number}} characters long.
connection.user-name-control-characters: A user name can't contain line breaks or other control characters.
connection.password-without-user-name: Enter the user name that goes with the password.
connection.user-name-without-password: Enter the password that goes with the user name, or leave both empty if {{service}} lets this app in without signing in.

secret.api-key-blank: A new API key can't be blank.
secret.api-key-too-short_one: An API key must be at least {{count, number}} character long.
secret.api-key-too-short_other: An API key must be at least {{count, number}} characters long.
secret.api-key-too-long_one: An API key can be at most {{count, number}} character long.
secret.api-key-too-long_other: An API key can be at most {{count, number}} characters long.
secret.api-key-characters: An API key can contain only visible characters, without spaces, quotes or backslashes.
secret.password-blank: A new password can't be blank.
secret.password-control-characters: A password can't contain line breaks or other control characters.

path.dot-segment: “{{path}}” contains . or .. as a folder name. Write the folder's full path without them.

path-map.not-full-path: “{{path}}” is not a full path the app can map.
path-map.not-full-path-back: “{{path}}” is not a full path the app can map back.
path-map.unwritable-folder-name: “{{path}}” can't be written under “{{prefix}}”: its folder name “{{name}}” contains \, which separates folders in a Windows path.
path-map.not-covered: No path mapping of this integration covers “{{path}}”.
path-map.not-covered-back: No path mapping of this integration leads to “{{path}}”.
path-map.ambiguous: The path mappings of this integration send “{{path}}” to different places: “{{first}}” and “{{second}}”.
path-map.ambiguous-back: The path mappings of this integration lead to “{{path}}” from different places: “{{first}}” and “{{second}}”.

path-mapping.no-file-paths: {{service}} reports no file paths, so it takes no path mappings.
path-mapping.too-many_one: An integration can have at most {{count, number}} path mapping.
path-mapping.too-many_other: An integration can have at most {{count, number}} path mappings.
path-mapping.service-path-missing: Each path mapping needs the folder as {{service}} sees it.
path-mapping.app-path-missing: Each path mapping needs the folder as this app sees it.
path-mapping.too-long_one: A path in a path mapping can be at most {{count, number}} character long.
path-mapping.too-long_other: A path in a path mapping can be at most {{count, number}} characters long.
path-mapping.control-characters: A path in a path mapping can't contain line breaks or other control characters.
path-mapping.not-full-path: “{{path}}” is not a full path. Start it with / (Linux) or a drive letter such as D:\ (Windows).
path-mapping.mixed-styles: All the paths of {{service}} in one integration must be of one kind: Linux-style (/…) or Windows-style (D:\…).
path-mapping.mapped-twice: The path “{{path}}” of {{service}} is mapped twice. Keep one mapping for it.
path-mapping.nested-windows-on-linux: “{{inner}}” is inside “{{outer}}”. With Windows paths on the {{service}} side and Linux paths in this app, keep only one of them.
path-mapping.nested-disagree: The mappings for “{{outer}}” and “{{inner}}” send “{{inner}}” to different places: “{{viaOuter}}” and “{{innerApp}}”. Remove one, or make them agree.

stored-secret.password-unreadable: The stored password of “{{name}}” can't be read with this installation's encryption key. Enter the password again and save.
stored-secret.api-key-unreadable: The stored API key of “{{name}}” can't be read with this installation's encryption key. Enter the API key again and save.

catalog.not-connected: Connect a metadata catalog under Integrations first.

list.kind-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a kind of integration. Use MediaLibrary, ReleaseSearch, DownloadClient or Metadata.

service.adapter-type-missing: Choose the service to connect to.
service.adapter-type-unknown: “{{value}}” is not a service this app can connect to.
service.secret-mode-invalid: A secret change must be Keep, Set or Clear.
service.adapter-unavailable: This version of the app can't connect to “{{type}}”, so this integration can only be removed.

connection-test.edited-integration-missing: The integration you are editing no longer exists. Close the dialog and reload the page.
